entity_raw.definition_raw: Cooperation SubdomainSource Inner Sea Gods pg. 224, Champions of Purity pg. 20Associated Domain(s): CommunityAssociated Deities: Arqueros, Bharnarol, Elion, Hembad, Matravash, Mazludeh, Nephthys, Svarozic, UlonReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the calming touch ability of the Community domain.Synergistic Touch (Sp): You can touch a creature as a standard action to confer upon it the benefits of any one Teamwork feat that you possess. This effect persists for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum 1). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—borrow skill, 2nd—share language, 3rd—coordinated effort.
